items.title: George "Jug" Jernberg Interview, 1963-08-23
items.q: he come back to Chicago to Smiley Corbett's Cafe there... And I went down to hear them play.

ctx.x: Because for his dance, he needed a great band.

Well, I tell you, he heard this Browns band from Dixieland in New Orleans, and he come back to Chicago to Smiley Corbett's Cafe there, the Lamb's Cafe, raving about this Browns band from Dixieland. And he kept on raving and kept on raving until Smiley Corbett finally gave up and had the band come up. And Corbett was still of the old school, pretty much. He thought they ought to be playing dinner music at night, you know. Boy, what a joke that is. Yeah. So, the full band didn't play the dinner music. The red brown…
